task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use the left arm to grab the medium metal can and place in the basket with handle, lift the basket with handle with another arm.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用左臂抓住中号金属罐放入带把手的篮子中，用另一只手臂提起带把手的篮子。
